title: Hedgehog wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- hedgehog body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='32' ry='22' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='20' ry='13' fill='#f0c892'/>
  <!-- spines: multiple triangles around top and sides -->
  <g fill='#6b3410'>
    <polygon points='22,60 14,44 30,52'/>
    <polygon points='30,52 24,32 40,46'/>
    <polygon points='40,46 36,24 52,42'/>
    <polygon points='52,42 50,20 66,40'/>
    <polygon points='66,40 66,20 78,42'/>
    <polygon points='78,42 82,28 88,48'/>
    <polygon points='88,48 94,38 92,58'/>
  </g>
  <!-- second layer spines lighter -->
  <g fill='#8a4b1e'>
    <polygon points='26,58 20,46 34,54'/>
    <polygon points='36,50 32,32 46,46'/>
    <polygon points='48,44 48,26 60,42'/>
    <polygon points='62,42 64,26 74,44'/>
    <polygon points='76,46 82,34 86,52'/>
  </g>
  <!-- face snout -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='72' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#e0a96d'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='72' r='4' fill='#3b1f0a'/>
  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <g fill='#1a1a2e' stroke='#7a5cff' stroke-width='1.2'>
    <rect x='26' y='62' width='16' height='9' rx='3'/>
    <rect x='44' y='62' width='16' height='9' rx='3'/>
    <rect x='41' y='65' width='4' height='2.5'/>
  </g>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <g fill='#a8c8ff' opacity='0.8'>
    <rect x='29' y='64' width='4' height='2' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='47' y='64' width='4' height='2' rx='1'/>
  </g>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M28 80 Q34 85 40 80' stroke='#3b1f0a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='89' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#8a4b1e'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='89' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#8a4b1e'/>
</svg>
